summary: Verified the blue-circle splash-spinner routing bug is fixed. RootNavigation in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx now redirects any logged-in user NOT in the (app) group to /(app), which covers both /(auth)/* AND the bare root '/'. All 12 checks PASSED on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844): (1) Fresh visitor with cleared storage redirected to login in ~0.13s on both viewports (splash not stuck). (2) Admin login (admin@fourbuy.co.za/admin123) succeeded and rendered ADMIN COCKPIT on desktop / 'Fourbuy Admin' mobile tabs on mobile within ~0.15s. (3) THE KEY REGRESSION: after admin login, navigating to the bare root URL redirected into the dashboard in 0.11-0.13s on both viewports (splash-screen testID no longer stuck). (4) New dealer registration succeeded and landed on 'My Submissions'. (5) Dealer refresh-at-root also redirected within 0.13s. Tab-bar padding regression check on mobile: admin submissions last card bottom=717 vs tabbar top=791 (74px clearance), admin dealers last card bottom=717 vs tabbar top=790 (73px clearance), admin profile Sign Out bottom=360 vs tabbar top=790, dealer profile Sign Out bottom=526 (visually above tab bar). No content is obscured by the bottom tab bar. No new backend or frontend issues introduced.

test_matrix.fresh_visitor_desktop: PASS (login form in 0.13s, splash not stuck)
test_matrix.fresh_visitor_mobile: PASS (login form in 0.12s, splash not stuck)
test_matrix.admin_profile_tabbar_padding_mobile: PASS (Sign Out clearly above tab bar)
test_matrix.dealer_profile_tabbar_padding_mobile: PASS (Sign Out clearly above tab bar)

critical_code_review_comments: The redirect fix at _layout.tsx:44-54 correctly covers the /(auth)/* AND '/' bare-root cases by inverting the check to `user && !inAppGroup`. This is the clean fix. Note however that at the very first render the segments hook may briefly return [] before Expo Router resolves, which is exactly why the previous fix was needed. Since the useEffect re-runs on segments change, the redirect will fire as soon as segments update. Good.

The safety-net splash hide at _layout.tsx:72-77 still fires at 2.5s unconditionally. Combined with the new redirect logic this is fine — an authenticated user landing on '/' will now be replaced with /(app) rapidly.

Prior-iteration flags still standing (not regressed by this change and not blocking): deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event, Pydantic .dict() calls, photos embedded as base64 in submission docs, useIconFonts uses jsdelivr CDN. Worth revisiting in a future iteration.
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway dealer account (dealer_<timestamp>@test.com / Dealer123!) via the register screen to exercise the dealer login and refresh-at-root flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blue-spinner routing bug fixed and verified. Base URL: https://fourbuy-admin.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: admin@fourbuy.co.za / admin123. Dealer: register a fresh one — the 'dealer.test@example.com / Dealer123!' from test_credentials.md is documented as illustrative and is NOT seeded in the DB. Backend under /api. On desktop viewport admins see WebAdminDashboard (ADMIN COCKPIT); on mobile viewport admins see the same tabbed layout as dealers ('Fourbuy Admin' with Submissions/Dealers/Profile tabs) — this is expected. Tab-bar padding on mobile is correct across all 4 screens.
rca_of_issue: Confirmed the RCA in the request: RootNavigation only redirected between (auth) <-> (app) groups. When a logged-in user landed on '/', segments[0] was undefined, so neither `!user && !inAuthGroup` nor `user && inAuthGroup` matched, and the splash ActivityIndicator rendered indefinitely. The fix changes the second branch to `user && !inAppGroup` — this correctly covers the bare-root case AND any /(auth)/* screen a logged-in user might land on. Playwright verified the redirect fires in 0.11-0.13s on both viewports for both admin and dealer users.
